text:
ENERJİNG AL-YAWN AL-'AAM
Tatm'ar sama al-yawm bi-taqa 'Iskandariyya farida, tu'azziz fi nawafidh al-fa'l al-hasan wa-tadfa'uka nahwa al-ibda'. Tashkur al-zuroof al-muhitiyya 'ala al-infitah al-dhihni, mumma yaj'aluka qadiran 'ala isti'ab akbar qadr min al-ma'lumat bi-sur'a gheyra ma'huda. Ruhuka al-marha al-yawm tajlib al-bahja li-man hawlaka, wa tash'ur bi-raghba 'amima fi 'i'adat al-nazar fi ba'd al-mashroo'at al-mu'allaqa. Innahu yawm mumtaz li-tawjeeh dhihnika al-mutawaqqid نحو ahdaaf jadida wadiha.

AL-'ISQ WA AL-'ALAAQAT
Li-l-murtabitween, al-yawm yajlib ma'ahu furSan ra'i'ah li-ta'zeez al-tواصل al-'amiq ma'a al-sharik, wa hal ay khilaf qadim bi-marunah wadiha. Al-'uzzaab qad 'alaqoon shakhsatan jadidatan yuthiru ihtimamahum min al-luqlaq al-awwal, fa-la tatawwajs min ibda' al-masha'ir bi-Sidq. Tawasul al-kalimat al-latifah sayakoon muftah al-quloob al-yawm, fa-la tabkhal bi-kalima tayyiba tus'id man tuHib.

AL-'AMAL WA AL-KARIYAR
Fi majal al-'amal, tatamatta' al-yawm bi-qudra fariqa 'ala al-tafkir al-istratiji alladhi yumayyizuka, fa-istaghlal hadhihi al-mawhiba li-hall al-masa'il al-'asida. Qad tataqaLLaqa furSan muhimmata li-tawsee' shabakat 'alaqatika al-mihniyya aw taqdeem afkar mubtakarah tunal i'jab al-mudoora'in. Kun musta'iddan li-l-mubadara wa-la tataqad daman fi ikhdar al-ara' al-mubdi'ah amam zumala'ika.

AL-MAAL WA AL-BARAKAH
Al-wad' al-madi yashhad istiqraru malhoza, ma ya'tihi fursah li-tawjeeh ba'd al-mowarid nahwa istithmarat mustaqbaliyya dhi qeema. Ihtaris min al-infidaat ghayr al-madrooSa fi shira' al-kamaliyyat al-yawm, fa-al-wa'y al-mali sayahmaaka mustaqbalan. Al-barka tutaraffaq bi-khuTawatika al-maliyya idha ahsantal tadbeer wa al-i'tidal fi al-sarf.

AL-SIHHA WA AL-TAQA
Sihhatuka al-badaniyya wa al-dhihniyya tahtajju ila ba'd al-i'tina' al-khasse, fa-la tuHmil raHat al-jasad wasat ziham al-maham. Mumarsat ba'd al-tamareen al-riyadiyya al-khafifah aw al-tamaddud sayusa'iduka 'ala tafreeg al-taqa al-salbiyya. Ihris 'ala shurb al-ma' bi-kammiyyat kafiyah wa al-husool 'ala nawm 'amiq yumadduka bi-al-nashad.

AL-TINWASUL WA AL-MUHIT
Al-hayat al-ijtima'iyya nashta wa-mali'ah bi-al-hayaah, fa-al-aWqat al-jameelah ma'a al-asdiqa' wa al-'a'ila satujlib al-kathir min al-suhba al-tayyiba. Qad tatallaqa da'wah ghayr mutawaqqa'ah li-liqa' ijtima'i yumkin an yaftaha abwaban jadidatan li-ta'aruf 'ala wujooh mumtazah. Isma' bi-inssaf li-man hawlaka, fa-qad tajid al-kitheer min al-da'm al-nafsi al-ladhi taHtajuhu fi kalaman baste.

NASIHAT AL-YAWN
"I'tamid 'ala mirunatika al-fariqa li-tajawwuz al-'uqabaat, fa-al-riyah al-tayyiba ta'ti li-man ya'rifu kayfa yunawwiru shira'ahu."

TAFASEEL AL-YAWN
Al-raqam al-hazeez: 5
Al-lawn al-hazeez: Al-Asfar al-Mishriqi
Al-burj al-mutawafiq: Al-Meezan
